verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
I have a home, eternal home
But for now I walk this broken world
You walked it first, You know our pain
But You show hope can rise again up from the grave

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Abide with me,
Abide with me, don’t let me fall
and don’t let go, walk with me
and never leave, ever close,
God, abide with me

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
There in the night
Gethsemane before the Cross
Before the nails, overwhelmed
Alone, You prayed, You met us in our suffering
and bore our shame

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Love that will not ever let me go
O, love that will not ever let me go
You never let me go
Love that will not ever let me go

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
And up ahead, eternity
We’ll weep no more and sing for joy,
abide with me, we’ll weep no more
And sing for joy, abide with me
